services.name: Hinckley Yachts
services.desc: In September 2018 Hinckley Yachts announced the opening of a new yard in Annapolis, MD. The area can store and service over 200 boats. Charlie Petosa, who has service experience as a former chief operating officer of Northrop & Johnson Yachts-Ships, joined Hinckley Yacht Services to lead the yard. Petosa also served as vice president of sales and marketing for Ocean Marine Yacht Center, as a board member of the U.S. Superyacht Association and led West Marine’s expansion into the superyacht segment with West Marine Megayacht Supply. services.name: Adventure Charters
services.desc: Hinckley Yachts was founded in 1928 in Maine. They manufacture, service and sell luxury sail and powerboats. They have developed yacht technologies including JetStick and Dual Guard composite material, and are an early developer of the fiberglass hull. Currently, Hinckley operates service yards in seven locations along the east coast of the United States, making it one of the most integrated boating concerns in the United States. Hinckley’s present yacht line includes boats ranging in size from 29 to 55 feet.
